overviewParagraphs: Taekwang Jeongsan Country Club occupies a unique position in Vietnam's golf landscape — literally. Situated on a river island south of Ho Chi Minh City, the club is accessible exclusively by private speedboat from the Saigon River pier, making the journey to the first tee a uniquely cinematic experience.

Designed by Ron Fream of Golfplan, the layout is known for its use of challenging, strategic bunkering and strong par-4 corridors through dense tropical vegetation. The course offers a private, exclusive atmosphere that stands in sharp contrast to the busier resort circuits around the city.

Taekwang Jeongsan caters to a discerning clientele seeking a private-members experience in southern Vietnam. For the discerning golf traveller who has played the standard Saigon circuit, this destination offers something genuinely different and memorable.

curatorBriefHtml: Taekwang Jeongsan Country Club is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, crafted by Golfplan / Ron Fream (2012) and stretching to 7,174 Yards across a championship layout environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its private river speedboat transfer (30-min cruise from downtown Saigon) and island breeze & tree-lined fairways (Refreshing river micro-climate).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Taekwang Jeongsan Country Club (Private speedboat (Saigon River)) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie consistency & professionalism (Disciplined service), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Ho Chi Minh City golf tour by AGS, Taekwang Jeongsan Country Club provides a distinct architectural test by Golfplan / Ron Fream that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.
